reviews.review_title: Nice escape room, but not worth the $$$
reviews.review_description:
I liked the game and had been waiting for it for a while. I was shocked when I escaped the first room and there was no more. The ending almost makes you think their is more. I restarted In case their was a glitch, but nope! That was it! I'd definitely rather have my $17 back. Not worth it. If you get it on sale for $3-5, that's worth it. I definitely feel cheated. It took me less than 30 minutes to beat it. If I was someone with limited funds and could only choose one game, I'd be very upset that I'd wasted it on this. The creators can't possibly think this is a fair price for the game. I paid this much for Memoreum. That game had 24 hours worth of gameplay. 
To the people who keep saying they cant wait for the next room.....this isn't early access! It's the complete game! I've played free demos that were longer.

I see a couple of unfair ratings, surely you are paying for a unique experience, this is one of those.
I think the graphics are really nice,the movement was smooth for me, I think for novice puzzlers a hint system might be handy.
The puzzles are very clever and voice acting is really good.
I’m hoping more rooms will be come available as I have enjoyed playing this so far.
Price is a little high if it’s only the one room.

One downside 
Pointing to input numbers dies need addressing, as I could not point a finger & had to use the back of my hand.
But I did enjoy the puzzles.

$15 for a game that takes about 20 minutes to complete is not worth it. Some of the puzzles were well thought out, but there were issues with physics, object collision, and the narrative is extremely shallow. I love supporting small publishers, but this is more of a tech demo than a full fledged game. Save your money and watch someone play a walkthrough when you have a few minutes to spare.

reviews.review_title: A Clever Twist on Escape Rooms! 🔍
reviews.review_description: This game delivers a smooth and engaging escape room experience with a clever twist. Instead of escaping, you're challenged to stay and uncover clues within the same room. This setup makes it easy to explore different areas, come back, and progress through the story. The clean and immersive graphics and solid execution make it stand out. It feels like a genre of its own. I'll definitely return to solve more puzzles and help Amelia on her journey—though I'll admit, the occasional online walkthrough helps keep things moving!
Good idea, atmospheric game, it's a pity that there's only one room for now, I'll be waiting for new Amelie's escapes 😊

reviews.review_title: Good game but way too short
reviews.review_description: I enjoyed playing the game but it is way too short. I was looking to explore a different room once I got out the first. Not worth the purchase!!!!!!!

I really enjoyed Amelia's Escape. The room looks great, the puzzles are clever, and the story kept me engaged from start to finish. My only disappointment is the length—I completed it in about an hour and wished there was at least a second room or another chapter to continue Amelia's adventure. Hopefully this is only the beginning because the foundation is excellent.

This is a charming little puzzle adventure with some nice little puzzles without time pressures. The environment is great with lots to see, the atmosphere is enjoyable, and there's a nice sense of satisfaction when you work out the puzzles and find your way forward.  Beware there is no hint support so in this escape room you are alone, that said they are not too hard to solve and quite rewarding when you do.
The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that I would have loved a little more rooms and a bit more polish in places. There is a bit of scene clipping, the physics need a tweak and boy is it a bit short at around 30 to 40 minutes play. Even so, it's a fun adventure that's well worth playing if you enjoy escape-style puzzles in VR.  I just hope they add more rooms...

Nice idea, nice variety in puzzles.
But very short, hopefully they add more free content, and controls can sometimes be a bit clunky
